working_definition: Grouped author type 'Lai/Dm9 neuron' (L3_82) of the Konstantinides et al. 2022 wandering L3 optic lobe atlas: medulla-class lamina intrinsic neurons (Lai) and distal medullary amacrine neurons Dm9, not resolved from one another.

best_match.fbbt_term: immature adult optic lobe intrinsic neuron
best_match.fbbt_definition: Immature neuron that will have its synapses restricted to the optic lobe in the adult.

justification: Immature Lai (FBbt:00052316) is not under immature distal medullary amacrine neuron, and Dm9 (FBbt:00052315) is not under a lamina-specific parent, so the most specific anatomical common parent is immature adult optic lobe intrinsic neuron, which is more specific than immature adult optic lobe neuron (FBbt:00053539). Both also share the non-anatomical parent Notch OFF hemilineage secondary neuron.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Immature form of the lamina intrinsic neuron (Konstantinides et al., 2022). It is a Notch OFF hemilineage secondary neuron, born from a medulla forming neuroblast during the Hbn/Opa/Slp temporal window (Konstantinides et al., 2022).

other_candidates.fbbt_term: immature distal medullary amacrine neuron Dm9
other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Immature form of the distal medullary amacrine neuron Dm9 (Konstantinides et al., 2022). It is a Notch OFF hemilineage secondary neuron, born from a medulla forming neuroblast during the Hbn/Opa/Slp temporal window (Konstantinides et al., 2022).
Secondary neuron belonging to a hemilineage that does not have active Notch signaling.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Common parent but not optic-lobe specific and not an immature term.

recommendation: Map to FBbt:00053540 'immature adult optic lobe intrinsic neuron' (broad match); members Lai and Dm9.
